scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:plugins
scripts.android: bun run build && ./gradlew :app:installDebug && adb shell am start -n com.letsmoe.otter/com.letsmoe.otter.MainActivity
scripts.android:release: bun run build && ./gradlew :app:installRelease && adb shell am start -n com.letsmoe.otter/com.letsmoe.otter.MainActivity
scripts.tv: bun run build && ./gradlew :tv:installDebug && adb shell am start -n com.letsmoe.otter.tv/.TvActivity
scripts.tv:emulator: bun run build:backend:emulator && bun run build:plugins && ./gradlew :tv:installDebug && adb -e shell am start -S -n com.letsmoe.otter.tv/.TvActivity
